## File: facebookresearch_llama-recipes/end-to-end-use-cases/Multi-Modal-RAG/scripts/final_demo.py

Prompts

```
['run the interactive fashion assistant Gradio demo with image upload and chat capabilities', 'create a LanceDB table with sentence transformer embeddings for clothing item descriptions', 'generate a detailed clothing item description from an uploaded image using Llama-Vision', 'retrieve similar clothing items using semantic, full text, or hybrid search methods', 'rewrite a user query to include relevant details from an item description using LLM', 'run multi-GPU image captioning on a folder of images using Llama 3.2 11b Vision model', 'find corrupt images in a folder and move them to a separate corrupt_images directory', 'check if a single image file is corrupt using PIL Image verify', 'process a chunk of images with Llama Vision model and write captions to a CSV file', 'generate JSON fashion captions with title, size, category, gender, type, and description for product images']
```

Usage

```
{'run_fashion_assistant_demo': 'run the interactive fashion assistant Gradio demo with image upload and chat capabilities', 'create_table_for_model': 'create a LanceDB table with sentence transformer embeddings for clothing item descriptions', 'generate_description': 'generate a detailed clothing item description from an uploaded image using Llama-Vision', 'retrieve_similar_items': 'retrieve similar clothing items using semantic, full text, or hybrid search methods', 'rewrite_query': 'rewrite a user query to include relevant details from an item description using LLM'}
```
